notes: Every source and target id is partitioned once; 16 source ids and 21 target ids all accounted for.

אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ has no English of its own once the ASV recasts שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ as *As thou hast served us*, so the noun and its suffix are `unrepresented`. The unit notes cite rule 22; the ground is simply that no English word answers to either morpheme, rule 22 governing repeated or resumptive elements. The marks themselves are right.
*As* is given to the second שֶׁ as the connective the ASV wrote for the morpheme standing at that clause's head, a present morpheme taking its English before an `added` reading under rule 11.

The beatitude frame divides as rule 20 and rule 46's first rider direct: the copula *shall ... be* with אַשְׁרֵי, discontinuous around *he*, and *he that* with the written שֶׁ, headed on *that* with *he* named as the competing head.
